item.title: Brazil Research Tour - 2 Days Out
item.description:
In two days I leave for over a month. I don’t speak the language, and apparently shorts are not well received in some areas. I am incredibly excited, but it has also been a long time since I have been away from home like this. Much less, the closest example I have is a youth camp on the Frio River haha. This is much different. At first I was slightly nervous about it all as you can imagine, but telling myself how unique this is makes it more exciting. With how often we will be flying, I will be unable to take film or my camera on this trip… So I bought a new one. Known for its film simulations: the FujiFilm X100. I figure this is a great time to learn digital photography.

Maybe I will also detox technology while away. Try to escape the black hole of Instagram Reels and Youtube. I’ve got some books I need to read, the first of which is The Crossing by Cormac McCarthy. I plan on posting when I return with some pictures for anyone to enjoy.

Peace out.

item.title: DC ASEBP Conference
item.description:
I was able to visit Washington D.C. for the first time in 20 years last week. Prior to that I came with my family when I was too young to remember anything. It was good to be out and see all the things to see again with the ability to appreciate them now. I took a camera, and with the remaining afternoon from travel, I started walking.

I didn’t really have a plan, I just wanted to get to the National Mall and hit some museums while walking East to West to see all of the monuments. I was able to see the Smithsonian of Natural History, Air & Space, and the Holocaust museums. If I had the time to take all day in those three places I easily could have, but even just going through quickly was easily the most exciting part of the trip. The war memorials were another highlight of it all, a little more private, and something you don’t really understand or appreciate as a kid.

The next three days were spent with coworkers at the American Society of Evidence Based Policing Conference. This was the first work conference I had ever attended and it wasn’t too bad. It was a unique experience just being able to listen to people a lot smarter than me talk about their passions and what interests them.

I was really most excited to just take some pics while there too, here are some good ones :)

item.title: First Roll
item.description:
Every roll of film starts in the dark. You load it, close the camera, and trust the process. The image already exists somewhere, you just have not seen it yet.

That felt like the right metaphor for starting this.

Developed is where I will put things that do not fit neatly elsewhere. Observations from research work that do not belong in a paper. Thoughts on tools and technology I am tinkering with. Maybe some pictures I have taken. No strict format, no posting schedule. Just things worth developing.

First rolls are always a little uncertain, but that’s the fun in it.
